title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.

providers.name: Datadog
providers.scope_notes: IP documentation differs on entitlement (Pro+ via support vs Enterprise). Confirm contract. AWS WIF requires supported integration/configuration.

controls.name: Application key scopes
controls.what: Restricts an application key to the listed authorization scopes instead of all of its owner's permissions.
controls.setting: Organization Settings > Application Keys (edit key scopes); Key Management API
controls.quote: Scoped application keys are granted only the scopes specified by the user

controls.name: API Keys Write permission
controls.what: Only roles holding api_keys_write can create or rename API keys (Admin role by default).
controls.plan: Custom roles may require an eligible plan (not confirmed)
controls.quote: Create and rename API Keys for your organization.

controls.name: User App Keys / Org App Keys Write permissions
controls.what: Controls who can create and manage their own application keys (user_app_keys) or anyone's keys (org_app_keys_write).
controls.quote: View and manage Application Keys owned by the user.

controls.name: Service Account Write permission
controls.what: Limits who can create, disable and use service accounts that own application keys.
controls.setting: Organization Settings > Roles; Organization Settings > Service Accounts
controls.quote: Create, disable, and use Service Accounts in your organization.

controls.name: One-Time Read (OTR) mode
controls.what: Shows application key secrets only once at creation; becomes permanent after 3 months enabled.
controls.setting: Organization Settings > Application Keys (requires org_app_keys_write + org_management)
controls.quote: When OTR mode is enabled, application key secrets are only displayed once during creation.

controls.name: Actions API access (per application key)
controls.what: Application keys cannot call the Actions APIs unless explicitly enabled per key.
controls.setting: Organization Settings > Application Keys or API
controls.quote: By default, application keys cannot be used with these APIs.

controls.name: IP Allowlist
controls.what: Blocks UI, public API and OAuth app access from IPs outside the list; Agent intake and some endpoints are exempt.
controls.setting: Organization Settings > Security > IP Allowlist; IP Allowlist API; Terraform ip_allowlist (Org Management permission)
controls.plan: Pro+ or Enterprise, enabled via support (API reference says Enterprise)
controls.quote: When the IP allowlist is enabled, only IP addresses or CIDR ranges in the allowlist can access the Datadog API and UI.

controls.name: Revoke API key / application key
controls.what: Revoked API keys can be restored for 7 days; application key revocation is permanent.
controls.setting: Organization Settings > API Keys / Application Keys; Key Management API
controls.quote: Revoking an application key is permanent.

controls.name: Unused Application Keys (Governance Console control)
controls.what: Detects application keys unused for a set period (default 30 days) and can automatically revoke them.
controls.setting: Governance Console > Controls > Unused Application Keys > Enforce control

controls.name: Unused API Keys (Governance Console control)
controls.what: Detects API keys unused for a set period and can automatically revoke them.
controls.setting: Governance Console > Controls > Unused API Keys > Enforce control

controls.name: Leaked API Keys (Governance Console control)
controls.what: Detects active API keys found exposed publicly by Datadog token leak detection, with optional enforcement.
controls.setting: Governance Console > Controls > Leaked API Keys

no_control.what: No expiration or maximum lifetime for API or application keys.

controls_unknown: No org setting found that blocks personal application keys or forces service-account-only keys.

Whether the IP allowlist applies to API-key and client-token requests outside telemetry intake is not stated; entitlement differs between account docs (Pro+/Enterprise) and API reference (Enterprise).
Plan requirement for Agent-based WIF: current WIF page lists no tier; earlier material says Enterprise-only and preview.
How to delete or disable an identity mapping is not documented on the WIF page; intake mappings are deleted via API.
Whether custom roles (needed to narrow these permissions) require a specific plan was not confirmed.

authentication.summary: Organization API key, often combined with a user/service-account application key; OAuth for supported apps; workload federation for supported scenarios.

federation.details: This path uses a local/static or platform-native credential. Evaluate a separate federation path where listed.

ip_restriction.boundary: Org IP allowlist applies to UI/API, with documented intake/public-dashboard exceptions. Not a per-key rule.

renewal.summary: API/application keys require explicit rotation or revocation.

administration.summary: Application-key scopes, service accounts, role permissions, OAuth grants, IP allowlist and key revocation.
administration.conditions: IP allowlist docs still differ on entitlement (account docs: Pro+ or Enterprise, via support; API reference: enterprise-only). Confirm contract. AWS WIF requires the Datadog-AWS integration.

offboard.details: Disabling a user revokes the application keys they created, but API keys they created stay valid.

inventory.details: Organization Settings > API Keys lists all org API keys (API Keys Read), and Org App Keys Read shows application keys of all users.

reads.ui: Audit Trail explorer (Organization Settings > Audit Trail); query @evt.name:"Log Management" @asset.type:logs_query, narrow by API Key ID / actor facet

offboard.ui: Organization Settings > Users > Edit > Disable toggle > Save (revokes app keys); then Organization Settings > API Keys > Revoke for API keys the user created

token_format.prefix: ddapp_ (new application keys); API keys: null
token_format.notes: New app keys use ddapp_ prefix; legacy app keys and API keys have no documented prefix. GitHub detects datadog_api_key and datadog_app_key.

log_sources.notes: Last used timestamp per key; Audit Trail extends history.

containment.steps: Revoke API key in Organization Settings > API keys (restorable 7 days); revoke app key in Application Keys (permanent). Rotate: create new key, update services, then revoke.
containment.notes: Revocation may take a few seconds to propagate. Disabling a user revokes their app keys but NOT API keys they created.
